LAREDO, Texas — Fredy Roman Arriaga was arrested Thursday, October 22, 2026, at 3:44 p.m., and booked into the Webb County Jail on an alleged second-degree felony charge of sexual assault, according to Webb County booking records.

The Laredo Police Department made the arrest, the records show. Arriaga, 42, is being held for out-of-county authorities on a Harris County Sheriff's Office warrant.

No bond had been set on the charge as of the booking record reviewed by Webb Watch 956.

A second-degree felony in Texas is punishable by two to 20 years in prison and a fine of up to $10,000.

An arrest is an allegation, not a conviction. Fredy Roman Arriaga is presumed innocent unless proven guilty in a court of law.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.
